summary: The filing is a Form 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $1 billion offering of 7.250% Series A Fixed-to-Fixed Reset Rate Junior Subordinated Notes due 2057 by Alexandria Real Estate Equities, Inc., guaranteed by its operating partnership. The notes are unsecured junior subordinated obligations with an initial fixed rate and reset features tied to five-year U.S. Treasury rates, plus a 2.889% spread. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No special-situation metrics apply.
